snippet.title: Entering Host Trailer
snippet.description:
Take control of a robotic parasite caught in a massive conflict between man and machine. Use its unique abilities to solve challenging puzzles and outsmart dangerous enemies in this bug-infested platformer.

Coming to Steam August 20th
